tier_should.rationale: Large, well-executed RCT with clear policy relevance; rigorous analysis, thoughtful heterogeneity, cost-effectiveness; contribution fits top-field or marginal general journal, though theory novelty limited.

tier_will.rationale: Renowned authors, NBER visibility, solid empirical design make AEJ-Applied/JDE publication highly likely; landing in top-five possible but less certain given mainly confirmatory cash effects and PM+ nulls.
